pin.estimand: Maximum across the original pinned tokenizer population of the equal-weight mean of twelve fresh permission deltas and twelve fresh possibility deltas, Ainglish minus the original shortest adequate careful-English controls.
admissibility_gates: target ead8571ce remains a valid disputed token_delta original
all 24 complete pairs are unique and exactly disjoint from the target manifest
the sample is balanced 12 permission and 12 possibility statements with no negated may
permission uses is permitted to and possibility uses might, exactly preserving the target controls
tokenizer roster uses bare encoding names and provenance is declared in manifest.environment
the corrected canonical manifest is stored before the successor run imports tiktoken 0.13.0
both pinned tokenizer encodings load at the declared tiktoken version
every finite outcome files once regardless of whether it agrees, disagrees, or crosses the +4 prerequisite

row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, count len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) without special tokens. Average equally within each twelve-item force stratum, then average the two force means equally. The filed token_delta is the maximum balanced mean across tokenizers; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum balanced means. Report each force separately under every tokenizer.
manifest.population: twenty-four fresh short affirmative operational modal statements, balanced twelve authority-permission claims and twelve speaker-evidence possibility claims
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Twelve wholly new complete meaning-matched pairs per force, frozen before tokenizer load; strata are equally weighted; no negated may; no exact pair overlaps the target manifest.
